purpose: Strengthen the MAIN-owned BC q-t projection by replacing its real SOS lower bound with the exact integer minimum of qBC at fixed (b,c,t), without terminal identity assumptions or additive stacking.

exact_integer_minimum.reason: For fixed u, x1+x9=u and x0+x6=t-u; each two-variable square sum is minimized by the most balanced integer split, while x5=b-u and x8+x10=c-t+u.
exact_integer_minimum.parity_quadratic: For parity p=u mod 2, 2*qBC_min candidate = 5*u^2-2*A*u+C+eps_p with A=2*b+2*t-c, C=2*b^2+t^2+(c-t)^2, eps_p=p+((t-p) mod 2)+((c-t+p) mod 2).
exact_integer_minimum.finite_candidate_rule: Within each parity class p, minimize |5*u-A| over u in [L,U] with u≡p (mod 2); because the quadratic coefficient is positive, the nearest admissible u to A/5 is exact.
exact_integer_minimum.necessary_projection: A BC histogram cell (b,c,qBC) permits only t with qBC_min(b,c,t)<=qBC.
exact_integer_minimum.dominance_over_real_sos: The exact integer minimum is at least the previous real Schur/SOS lower bound, so the integer t-set is a subset of the prior BC-QT projected t interval.

research_interpretation.promotion_required: FULL178 replay, independent source locks, hostile audit, and MIN-composition/no-double-charge proof before MAIN numerical credit.
